MINPROVISE INTERNATIONAL PTY LTD is a leading total solutions provider delivering specialist maintenance and shutdown services, engineering, fabrication, project services, and sustaining capital works. We also provide a comprehensive range of equipment and products, supporting the mining, oil & gas, and construction industries across Australia and internationally.

We are currently seeking an organised and motivated Project Administrator / Administrative Officer to join our growing team on a full-time basis.

About the Role
As a Project Administrator / Administrative Officer, you will provide administrative and project coordination support to project managers, engineers, supervisors, and operational teams. You will be responsible for maintaining project documentation, coordinating communications, monitoring project records, and ensuring administrative processes are completed accurately and efficiently to support the successful delivery of mining, industrial, and engineering projects.
Key Responsibilities
•	Provide administrative support to project managers, engineers, and operational teams.
•	Prepare, update, and maintain project documentation, reports, registers, and correspondence.
•	Coordinate project meetings, prepare agendas, record meeting minutes, and follow up on action items.
•	Maintain project schedules, document control systems, and filing systems.
•	Assist with project planning, resource coordination, procurement, and subcontractor documentation.
•	Process purchase orders, invoices, timesheets, and other project-related administrative records.
•	Liaise with clients, suppliers, subcontractors, and internal departments regarding project requirements and documentation.
•	Monitor project documentation to ensure compliance with company procedures and quality standards.
•	Assist with mobilisation, onboarding, travel arrangements, and accommodation bookings for project personnel where required.
•	Prepare progress reports, spreadsheets, and other administrative documents using Microsoft Office applications.
•	Maintain confidentiality and ensure accurate record-keeping at all times.
•	Comply with workplace health and safety policies, company procedures, and quality management systems.

Skills and Experience
•	Minimum 1–2 years of full-time experience in a Project Administrator, Administrative Officer, or similar administrative support role.
•	Experience supporting engineering, mining, construction, or industrial projects is highly regarded.
•	Strong organisational and time management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
•	Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
•	High level of accuracy and attention to detail.
•	Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, including Word, Excel, Outlook, and PowerPoint.
•	Experience using project management or document control systems will be highly regarded.
•	Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced team environment.

What We Offer
•	Full-time, permanent employment.
•	Competitive salary of $75,000 – $95,000 per annum.
•	Opportunities to work on major mining, shutdown, engineering, and industrial projects.
•	Ongoing training and professional development.
•	Supportive team environment with long-term career opportunities.

Are you an organised administrative professional seeking a long-term career opportunity with an iconic, proudly Australian market leader?  
 Randstad is proud to partner with a premier consumer food producer supplying major supermarkets, food service providers, and quick-service restaurant partners across Australia daily. Founded as a family business in 1918, this highly successful organisation has spent over a century building a reputation for quality, convenience, and operational excellence. Driven by a commitment to sustainability and a "people first" philosophy, they invest heavily in the future of their teams and pride themselves on a safe, structured, and genuinely supportive working environment. 
 Operating out of a high-performing manufacturing hub in  Lytton , this position represents a key operational anchor for the facility, transitioning directly from an initial temporary period into a long-term permanent contract.    
 Why Apply? 
 This position is ideal for an administrator looking to combine competitive industry pay with an enviable lifestyle roster. 
 
 
  Attractive Pay Rate:  $38.00-$40.00 per hour + super (casual rate during the initial temporary probation period), potential permanent salary of $68K + super 
 
 
  Work-Life Balance:  A structured 38-hour professional work week featuring consistent daytime hours and an early finish every Friday. 
 
 
  Career Stability:  Step into a secure, long-term role within a massive national supply network that prioritises employee rewards, workplace safety, and career longevity. 
 
 
  Schedule & Roster Structure 
 Enjoy a highly reliable, consistent roster designed to optimise your weekend availability: 
 
 
  Monday to Thursday:  7:00 AM - 3:00 PM 
 
 
  Friday:  7:00 AM - 1:00 PM (Start your weekend early!) 
 
 
  Commencement:  The ideal start is ASAP, though up to a two-week notice period can be accommodated. 
 
 
 About the Organisation 
 Our partner operates with a proud history and an uncompromising commitment to safety, continuous improvement, and sustainable food production. This facility runs tight, reliable operational workflows, providing a structured and stable workspace where your daily contributions are visible and valued. If you are looking for clear career pathways within an industry-leading team that values transparency, quality, and integrity, this is an excellent opportunity. 
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Based full-time at front reception, you will serve as the essential focal point for site operations. This multi-faceted role perfectly balances highly visible front-of-house customer service with rigorous back-end logistics, data entry, and compliance tracking. 
 Your daily responsibilities will include: 
 
 
  Front of House & Communications:  Greet and sign in visitors, transport providers, and site contractors, while managing site communications via email and Microsoft Teams. 
 
 
  Data Entry & Materials Logistics:  Input operational figures, manage inventory records, and track inbound/outbound material pipelines relating to finished bulk stock and raw materials. 
 
 
  Procurement & Financial Admin:  Utilise internal databases to raise purchase orders for raw materials and site supplies, process commercial quotes, and assist in organising figures for the site budget. 
 
 
  Quality Assurance Coordination:  Coordinate the preparation, dispatch, and digital documentation of operational product samples sent to external testing facilities, following up on results. 
 
 
  Site Housekeeping:  Maintain general administrative spaces, restock office infrastructure (such as printers), and manage structured physical and digital filing systems. 
 
 
  Key Selection Criteria 
 We are looking for a systematic, proactive professional who works effectively toward strict operational deadlines. 
 
 
  Relevant Experience:  A demonstrated background in a multi-faceted office environment encompassing reception duties, high-accuracy data entry, and proactive customer service. 
 
 
  Software Capability:  Intermediate to advanced operational proficiency with Microsoft Excel to track numbers, run formulas, and organise data sheets. Prior exposure to procurement or inventory databases is highly regarded. 
 
 
  Professional Communication:  Confidence collaborating with stakeholders at all levels, managing professional correspondence, and participating actively in digital team environments. 
 
 
  Time Management:  Exceptional organisational skills with a track record of meeting strict production or transport logistics deadlines reliably every week. 
 
 
   Ready to lock in a stable new career with a national leader?  Click  APPLY  today to begin your application with Randstad. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. 
   

 At Randstad, we are passionate about providing equal employment opportunities and embracing diversity to the benefit of all. We actively encourage applications from any background.

A growing commercial cleaning and facilities services business is seeking an experienced Corporate Services Manager to oversee business operations, service delivery, client relationships and portfolio performance across South Australia, Victoria and Western Australia.

This is a senior management position suited to someone with strong experience in commercial cleaning, facilities services, multi-site operations, client relationship management, workforce leadership and operational performance.

The successful candidate will work closely with the executive leadership team to ensure operational standards, labour performance, compliance, client satisfaction and business growth objectives are achieved.

About the Role

The Corporate Services Manager will be responsible for planning, coordinating and improving the administrative, operational and commercial functions of an allocated portfolio.

The role will involve oversight of service delivery, client relationships, staffing, performance management, compliance systems, reporting, audits, business improvement and portfolio development opportunities.

This role requires a hands-on leader who can manage competing priorities, support Area Managers and site teams, maintain strong client relationships and contribute to the continued growth and professionalism of the business.

Key Responsibilities

Responsibilities will include, but are not limited to:

Oversee the administration and operational performance of cleaning and facilities services across the allocated portfolio.
Work with the executive leadership team to support business planning, portfolio performance and strategic objectives.
Monitor labour-to-sales performance, roster structures, site profitability and operational results.
Manage client relationships and act as a senior escalation point for service delivery matters.
Identify opportunities for account growth, additional works, recharges, tender opportunities and new business leads.
Support tendering, quoting and commercial submissions where required.
Lead, support and performance manage Area Managers, Supervisors and cleaning teams.
Ensure appropriate staffing, training, succession planning and workforce coverage across the portfolio.
Monitor compliance with company systems, operational procedures, WHS requirements, audits, toolbox talks and site documentation.
Ensure cleaning standards, site presentation and service quality meet company and client expectations.
Support injury management and return-to-work processes in line with company HR and WHS protocols.
Review site performance data, audit outcomes, customer feedback and operational risks.
Implement process improvements to strengthen consistency, productivity and service delivery.
Represent the business professionally in client meetings, operational reviews and portfolio development activities.
Skills and Experience Required

The successful candidate will ideally have:

Previous experience in a senior operations, corporate services, facilities management or commercial cleaning management role.
Strong experience managing multi-site service delivery teams.
Demonstrated ability to manage client relationships and resolve operational issues quickly and professionally.
Experience with labour management, rostering, cost control and performance reporting.
Understanding of WHS, compliance, audits and quality standards in a service-based environment.
Ability to lead managers, supervisors and frontline employees across multiple locations.
Strong communication, problem-solving and stakeholder management skills.
Commercial awareness, including the ability to identify growth, quoting and additional service opportunities.
Strong computer literacy and ability to use business systems, reporting tools and operational platforms.
Current driver licence and willingness to travel as required across the allocated portfolio.
Qualifications

Relevant qualifications in business, management, operations, facilities management or a related field will be highly regarded.

Equivalent industry experience in commercial cleaning, facilities services, multi-site operations or service-based management will also be considered.

Senior full-time management role with a growing service-based business.
Salary range of $115,000 - $135,000 per annum plus superannuation.
Company vehicle and fuel card.
Laptop and mobile phone.
Opportunity to work closely with the executive leadership team.
Broad portfolio responsibility across SA, VIC and WA.
Long-term opportunity to contribute to business growth, service improvement and operational excellence.
How to Apply

Please submit your resume and a short cover letter outlining your experience in corporate services, facilities services, commercial cleaning operations, client management and team leadership.

We are an equal opportunity employer and encourage applications from suitably qualified candidates with the right skills, experience and work rights for the role.

## Position Overview
We are looking for a skilled and motivated Systems Administrator to join our team and take ownership of the organisation's IT infrastructure. In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring the stability, integrity, and efficient operation of our server environments, networks, and supporting systems. The ideal candidate is a proactive problem-solver with a strong technical background and a commitment to delivering reliable, secure, and high-performing IT services. This position suits an experienced professional who thrives in a dynamic environment and can manage both day-to-day operations and longer-term infrastructure planning.
## Key Responsibilities
- Install, configure, and maintain server hardware, operating systems, software, and associated infrastructure to ensure optimal performance and availability
- Diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve server-related hardware and software malfunctions across workstations, servers, and communication infrastructure, providing timely service support to minimise disruption
- Monitor network performance and system health on an ongoing basis, identifying potential issues and making proactive adjustments to maintain service quality and reliability
- Prepare and maintain comprehensive technical documentation, including operational procedures, system logs, configuration records, and IT policies and instructions
- Assess current and future infrastructure needs by regularly surveying existing systems and recommending enhancements to server capacity, network design, and technology implementation
- Ensure computer site design and layout allows all hardware and software components to integrate and function cohesively within the broader IT environment
- Manage system security measures including user access controls, patch management, antivirus solutions, and firewall configurations to protect organisational data and assets
- Plan, implement, and test backup and disaster recovery procedures to safeguard data integrity and ensure business continuity
- Administer and support databases, virtualisation platforms, and cloud-based services as required by the organisation
- Collaborate with IT team members, vendors, and internal stakeholders to deliver infrastructure projects and resolve escalated technical issues
- Provide guidance and technical support to end users and junior IT staff, promoting best practices and ensuring effective use of systems and tools
## Required Qualifications & Skills
- Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
- Proven experience in a Systems Administrator or similar IT infrastructure role
- Strong working knowledge of Windows Server and/or Linux operating systems, including installation, configuration, and maintenance
- Demonstrated experience with network administration, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPN, and firewall management
- Proficiency in virtualisation technologies such as VMware or Hyper-V
- Experience with backup and disaster recovery solutions and the ability to develop and test recovery procedures
- Sound understanding of IT security principles, including access management, patch management, and vulnerability remediation
- Ability to prepare clear technical documentation and maintain accurate system records
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to diagnose and resolve complex technical issues under pressure
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to liaise effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
- Demonstrated ability to manage competing priorities and work both autonomously and as part of a collaborative team
## Preferred Qualifications
- Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate or equivalent cloud certification
- Experience with cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud
- Familiarity with scripting languages such as PowerShell, Bash, or Python for task automation
- ITIL Foundation certification or experience working within an ITIL-aligned service management framework
- Experience with Active Directory, Group Policy, and Microsoft 365 administration
- Knowledge of monitoring tools such as Nagios, PRTG, or SolarWinds
- Prior experience working in an enterprise or multi-site environment
## Why Join Us?
- Be part of a supportive and collaborative IT team that values knowledge sharing, continuous improvement, and professional growth
- Access ongoing training, certification support, and clear pathways for career advancement within the organisation
- Enjoy a flexible working environment that promotes a healthy work-life balance, including hybrid working arrangements where applicable
- Contribute to meaningful infrastructure projects that directly impact the organisation's operations and strategic direction
- Competitive remuneration package with additional benefits, in an organisation that recognises and rewards performance
## Job Details
- Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
- Work Schedule: 8-hour shift
- Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Super

result.description:
Australian Fishing Enterprises (AFE) is the largest exporter of Southern Bluefin Tuna in Australia. Our tuna is exported around the world for sale in international marketplaces as a premium sushi/ sashimi product. We specialise in the fishing, ranching and grow out of Southern Bluefin Tuna and control the entire process from catching, feeding, harvesting, processing and delivery.
AFE 5 positions available for this role.

JOB SUMMARY:
The deckhand will carry out duties as directed by the Farm Manager or Vessel Masters.

OPERATIONS:
Periods at sea are varied and weather dependent. Hours of operation are determined by the daily operational needs.
Farm Operations:
Farm vessels can be required to conduct operations year round from land based sites out to the farming site. The season begins in December finishing with the annual harvest period throughout June, July & August.
January – July Operations are 7 days per week; you can work up to 6 days in a week. Up to 12 hours per day.
August to December Operations are 5 days per week Monday to Friday, you will work up to 5 days in a week, 8 hours per day

Offshore Operations:
Tow & Support operations begin in December through to late March. If Quota is exhausted quickly the Offshore Operations will cease before late March.
Hours of operation whilst at Sea are from Sunrise to Sunset plus a navigational watch. There are however periods of downtime.

CONTRACT PERIOD:
Approximate start date: AFE are offering start dates in November, December, January, February, March and April  for up to 9 Months

DUTIES:
The Employee will be required to perform the following duties whilst at sea on the Farm site.
• Ability to stand on unstable surfaces and undertake general duties on a day-to-day basis as advised by the Master
• Forklift operation (license required) onshore only (not essential but desirable)
• Loading and unloading of vessel at sea and on-shore
• Fish feeding, harvesting & processing
• Maintenance as directed by Vessel Engineer
• Repetitive manual labour
• Vessel cleaning and house keeping
• Vessel mooring/berthing
• Net mending
• Rope work (splicing, knotting etc.)
• Farm pontoon maintenance

OFFSHORE DUTIES:
The Employee will be required to perform the following duties whilst at Sea for Offshore Operations.
Navigation Watch:
• Keeping Lookout for other Vessels
• Maintaining Vessel Course as per Master’s instructions
• Vessel Log recording
• Watch Handover to next watch keeper
• Reporting to the Master
• Radio frequency monitoring

A Navigational watch can per performed at any time throughout the day or night, they are generally 1.5-2 hours in duration.
Deck Duties:
• Ability to stand on unstable surfaces and undertake general duties on a day-to-day basis as advised by the Master
• Tender vessel operation
• Launch and retrieval of tender
• Fish Sampling/Chumming
• Maintenance as directed by Vessel Engineer
• Repetitive Manual labour
• Vessel cleaning and house keeping
• Vessel Mooring/Berthing
• Net mending

Hours of operation whilst at Sea are from Sunrise to Sunset plus a navigational watch. There are however downtime periods. For example, if the vessel is steaming to different fishing grounds or is at anchor for the day due to weather the crew can indulge in R&R but will still be required to man a navigational watch in the evening.

This job description has been designed to indicate the general nature and level of work performed by employees within this classification. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities and qualifications required of employees assigned to the role.

INDUCTION & TRAINING:
• All crew are inducted onto the vessel prior to departure
• Safety drills conducted bi-monthly
• Deck machinery training and instruction conducted
• SOP’s to be discussed for operations

REMUNERATION:
FARM OPERATIONS
Renumeration is paid as per the Award Rate, paid on a fortnightly basis. Farm work completed inshore and onshore will be calculated at the applicable hourly Farm rate. Aquaculture Award:(https://awards.fairwork.gov.au/MA000114.html)(https://calculate.fairwork.gov.au/payguides/fairwork/ma000114
OFFSHORE OPERATIONS
An additional contract is put in place alongside original Deckhand Contract to cover the periods Offshore for Tow & Support operations to classify Duties and Remuneration (there is no Award that covers the "At Sea" roles), contract renumeration is calculated from experience and seamanship knowledge.

This is not a FIFO position. Successful applicants will need to based in Port Lincoln for the duration of the contracted period.
